t: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Sonnet 4.5 model (claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for November 30, 2026.
s: We recommend migrating to Claude Sonnet 5.5.

t: Claude Sonnet 5.5 launch
s: We just launched Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in our Claude 5.5 family. Sonnet 5.5 is a faster, lower-cost complement to Claude Opus 5.5.

t: Thinking blocks that Claude Sonnet 5.5 produces work only in the account that produced them, or in an account linked to it.
s: When another account sends one of these blocks, the API drops the block before the model sees it, and the request succeeds. Blocks from earlier models aren’t affected.
